limitations: Descriptive positivity differences, not outbreak diagnoses, calibrated p-values or population infection prevalence.
Calendar-complete, sufficiently tested observations do not establish reporting-site coverage; site coverage remains unverified.
Universal source provisional flags indicate revisable surveillance observations, not proof that the observation week is partial.
Historical references use this revised snapshot. They do not reconstruct information available when each historical week was first reported.
Missing, invalid, partial, projected and low-testing weeks are unavailable; absent weeks are never filled with zero.

plan.baseline: Specimen-weighted positivity within each qualifying historical five-week seasonal window; median across qualifying windows. All baseline weeks end before the target starts and belong to earlier ISO years. ISO week53 maps to week52 only if the historical year lacks53.
plan.missingness: Missing, invalid, partial, projected or low-testing weeks remain unavailable. Expected target weeks/countries are retained even without observations. Universal source provisional flags describe revisions, not proof of a partial week. Reporting-site coverage is unverified.
plan.outputs: Observed and baseline positivity, percentage-point difference, ratio when baseline is nonzero, specimen counts, coverage and row-quality diagnostics. Descriptive only; no p-values or diagnosis alerts.
plan.source_scope: WHO influenza_positivity, SENTINEL only, separate complete source/dimension streams
